query.policy: A document may be published only after its owner approval check has returned approved for that document AND the latest classification check for the same document reports public. Submitting a publication request does not publish it.

check_owner_approval.description: Check recorded owner approval for a document; no publication occurs.

check_classification.description: Check whether the document is public; no publication occurs.

submit_publication_request.description: Submit a request for future publication; does not publish.
